# Project: Norway AADT Sensor Placement Optimisation

**Goal**: Select k new traffic sensor locations that maximally reduce prediction uncertainty on unmeasured road links. Two-stage pipeline:
1. INLA Besag-proper weighted spatial model (`fit_weighted_inla_model()`) → posterior predictions on all links
2. Greedy mutual information (MI) sensor selection → ranked sensor locations

---

## Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `R/*.R` | Core function library — 6 modules (`inla-modeling`, `flow-conservation`, `covariance-matrices`, `sensor-selection`, `diagnostics`, `utilities`); `R/scripts_inla_sensor_placement.R` is a thin orchestrator that sources them all |
| `production/run_norway_sensor_selection.R` | Main pipeline script — run this to produce results consumed by the Shiny app |
| `analysis/` | Code and cached data used to produce the report (not experiments) |
| `experiments/` | Historical experiments/prototypes, grouped by topic — safe to ignore for day-to-day work, kept for reference |
| `results/` | Output `.rds` files, split by consumer: `production/` (feeds `shiny/app.R`), `analysis/` (feeds analysis scripts/reports only), `report/` (figures/data for the written report, generated by `analysis/results-sensor-selection.R`). Each `.rds` contains `selected_data_entries` + `summary` list |
| `shiny/app.R` | Interactive visualisation of results |
| `deploy.R` | Staging script that copies files into `shiny/` before rsconnect upload |

---

## Critical Deploy Rule

When adding a new result file to `configs` in `shiny/app.R`, you **MUST** also add the filename to `rds_files` in `deploy.R`. Omitting this causes the deployed app to crash on startup with exit status 1 (file not found in rsconnect bundle).

---

## R Conventions

- Use `|>` (not `%>%`)
- snake_case naming throughout
- tidyverse-first style
- `req()` / `validate(need(...))` in Shiny reactive contexts
